components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in a plaster room.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6b1d35; color: #fbf6ee; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; padding: 0.8rem 1.6rem; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #3d0f1d; transition: transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7a2c43; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6b1d35; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #3d0f1d; }

narrative.overview: The site is hung as a solo exhibition about one scientist. The person is the opening wall. Each project, method and data story is an exhibit in the rooms that follow. A section is a room, and a room is one flat coat of wall colour.
keyCharacteristics: Wall colour is used at room scale, never as a small accent.
One flat coat per room. No gradients, washes or glass.
Every card is the same label stock, wherever it hangs.
Buttons stand proud of the wall and press in when clicked.
One theme. There is no dark mode.

rules.name: The One Coat Rule
rules.body: A room is one flat colour from edge to edge. If a surface needs a gradient to look finished, it is the wrong surface.

rules.name: The Ink On Paper Rule
rules.body: A card always reads as ink on label stock. Cards re-declare the ink tokens for their own subtree, so this holds on any wall.

rules.name: The Second Cue Rule
rules.body: The four family colours are close in lightness. A chart never relies on colour alone: label series directly and add a second cue.

rules.name: The 14 Pixel Floor
rules.body: The Tailwind text tokens are redefined so text-xs is 14px. An arbitrary smaller size is a defect.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: A button moves down 4px and its edge shrinks to 1px while pressed. Nothing else on the site moves on hover.

dos: Do give a new section a room class (room-merlot, room-green or room-paper) and let the tokens do the rest.
Do put bg-card on any element that takes the card colour, so its text turns to ink.
Do keep article text at 60ch or less.
Do keep the four family colours for categories only, with a second cue in charts.
donts: Don't add gradients, washes, glass or gradient text.
Don't use brass on plaster or on a card.
Don't make cards lift, scale or animate on hover. Only buttons move, and only when pressed.
Don't dress a statement up as a quotation, a record or a signed document.
